notes.shared: Read by default from: Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Kimi Code, Grok Build. Antigravity also reads .agents/skills at project level.
notes.codex: User-level skills officially live only in Shared; ~/.codex/skills is a community myth that Codex never loads.
notes.claude-code: Independent plugin system: user-scoped plugins can be toggled below; project plugins are declared via settings.json.
notes.antigravity: agy and Antigravity 2.0 share ~/.gemini/config; plugins live in ~/.gemini/config/plugins (read-only for now).
notes.grok-build: Also reads Shared plus .claude/.cursor skills; independent plugin system at ~/.grok/plugins (read-only for now).
notes.kimi-code: Also reads Shared (~/.agents/skills); independent plugin system at ~/.kimi-code/plugins/managed (user-level only, read-only for now).
notes.qwen: Also reads Shared (~/.agents/skills); MCP servers are configured in ~/.qwen/settings.json. Extensions (~/.qwen/extensions) are listed read-only below; manage them with the `qwen extensions` CLI.
notes.zcode: Also reads Shared (~/.agents/skills); MCP servers are configured in ~/.zcode/cli/config.json. Marketplace plugins (~/.zcode/cli/plugins) are listed read-only below; toggle them in ZCode settings.
notes.workbuddy: Skills live in ~/.workbuddy/skills; MCP configured in ~/.workbuddy/mcp.json; manage native skills in WorkBuddy UI.
notes.dsh: Also reads Shared (~/.agents/skills). Skills live in ~/.dsh/skills (including single-file Markdown skills). MCP servers are cordis plugin instances of the profile (cordis.patch.yml, read-only below); the plugin system is the profile itself (dsh plugin add — not managed here).
